segments.sn35.148:1.2: Taṃ suṇātha … pe … katamā ca sā, bhikkhave, nibbānasappāyā paṭipadā?
segments.sn35.148:1.4: Idha, bhikkhave, cakkhuṃ dukkhanti passati, rūpā dukkhāti passati, cakkhuviññāṇaṃ dukkhanti passati, cakkhusamphasso dukkhoti passati, yampidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi dukkhanti passati … pe … jivhā dukkhāti passati … pe … mano dukkhoti passati, dhammā dukkhāti passati, manoviññāṇaṃ dukkhanti passati, manosamphasso dukkhoti passati, yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi dukkhanti passati.
segments.sn35.148:1.7: Ayaṃ kho sā, bhikkhave, nibbānasappāyā paṭipadā”ti.

lines: Paṭipāṭiyā pana catūsupi etesu suttesu saha vipassanāya cattāro maggā kathitā.
Nibbānasappāyā paṭipadā desitāti katvā “saha vipassanāya cattāro maggā kathitā”ti vuttaṃ.
